label: Reciprocal dependence in distinct…: Observation reports support other empirical propositions in…
term: reciprocal dependence in distinct logical dimensions and revisability
definition: Observation reports support other empirical propositions in one dimension, while relying on other knowledge in another. Sellars joins this to piecemeal self-correction, not simultaneous suspension of all claims. The passage does not identify this with one self-supporting inferential cycle.
